0: WITH county_avg AS (   SELECT AVG(F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / F.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_rate   FROM frpm AS F   INNER JOIN schools AS S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode   WHERE S.County = 'Alameda'     AND F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL     AND F.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 ) SELECT   S.School,   S.Charter,   S.GSserved,   CASE     WHEN T.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR T.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR T.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'     WHEN (T.AvgScrRead + T.AvgScrMath + T.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'     WHEN (T.AvgScrRead + T.AvgScrMath + T.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'     ELSE 'Above Average'   END AS sat_performance_level,   (F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / F.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - C.avg_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg FROM frpm AS F INNER JOIN schools AS S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores AS T ON S.CDSCode = T.cds CROSS JOIN county_avg AS C WHERE S.County = 'Alameda'   AND F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL   AND F.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 ORDER BY F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / F.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
2: SELECT T1.School, T1.Street, T1.City, T1.Zip, T1.County, T1.Latitude, T1.Longitude, T3.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T3.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS frpm_rate, T2.NumTstTakr, T2.AvgScrRead, T2.AvgScrMath, T2.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_rank, STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) AS open_year, T1.StatusType, CASE WHEN T3.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) > 75 THEN 'High FRPM' WHEN T3.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) >= 50 THEN 'Medium FRPM' WHEN T3.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Low FRPM' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS frpm_category FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T3.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
3: SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip, T2.County, T2.MailStreet, T2.Website, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, T3.enroll12, T3.NumTstTakr, T3.NumGE1500, T3.AvgScrRead, T3.AvgScrMath, T3.AvgScrWrite, CASE WHEN T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.7 AND T3.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / T3.NumTstTakr > 0.2 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM' WHEN T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 0.3 AND T3.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / T3.NumTstTakr < 0.1 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM' ELSE 'As expected' END AS performance FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode INNER JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.cds WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100 AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
8: SELECT T1.CDSCode, T1.School, T1.County, T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode INNER JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.cds WHERE T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 10
18: SELECT   CASE WHEN T1.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'Under 50 testers' WHEN T1.NumTstTakr < 100 THEN '50-100 testers' ELSE '100-250 testers' END AS testing_volume_category,   COUNT(T1.cds) AS school_count,   AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers,   AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading,   AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math,   AVG(T1.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode INNER JOIN frpm AS T3 ON T2.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'   AND T2.Charter = 1   AND T3.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'   AND T1.NumTstTakr <= 250 GROUP BY CASE WHEN T1.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'Under 50 testers' WHEN T1.NumTstTakr < 100 THEN '50-100 testers' ELSE '100-250 testers' END

60: SELECT   T1.School,   T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`,   T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,   T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS frpm_percent,   CASE     WHEN T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) > 75 THEN 'High Poverty'     WHEN T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) >= 50 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty'     WHEN T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) >= 25 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty'     ELSE 'Low Poverty'   END AS poverty_level,   T3.NumTstTakr,   T3.AvgScrRead,   T3.AvgScrMath,   T3.AvgScrWrite,   T3.NumGE1500,   RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.County ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS enrollment_rank FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'P' AND T1.Charter = 1 AND T1.County = 'San Joaquin' ORDER BY enrollment_rank

123: WITH loan_stats AS (     SELECT account_id,            COUNT(*) AS loan_count,            SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,            MAX(amount) AS max_loan_amount,            AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount     FROM loan     WHERE amount > 300000     GROUP BY account_id ), trans_stats AS (     SELECT account_id,            COUNT(*) AS txn_count,            SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,            SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense     FROM trans     GROUP BY account_id ), national AS (     SELECT AVG(A11) AS avg_salary FROM district ) SELECT a.account_id,        d.A2 AS district_name,        d.A3 AS region,        ls.loan_count,        ls.total_loan_amount,        ls.max_loan_amount,        ls.avg_loan_amount,        c.gender,        c.birth_date,        CASE            WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'            WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'            ELSE 'Low Income'        END AS income_category,        COALESCE(ts.txn_count, 0) AS txn_count,        COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,        COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,        CASE            WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) = 0 THEN NULL            ELSE (ts.total_income - ts.total_expense) * 1.0 / ts.total_income        END AS savings_ratio,        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY ls.max_loan_amount DESC) AS region_rank FROM account AS a INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id INNER JOIN loan_stats AS ls ON a.account_id = ls.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans_stats AS ts ON a.account_id = ts.account_id WHERE d.A11 > (SELECT avg_salary FROM national)   AND (ts.account_id IS NULL OR ts.total_income - ts.total_expense > 0) ORDER BY ls.max_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 100
139: SELECT C.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT D.disp_id) AS num_owners, AVG(A.avg_balance) AS average_balance FROM card AS K INNER JOIN disp AS D ON K.disp_id = D.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS C ON D.client_id = C.client_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS A ON D.account_id = A.account_id WHERE K.type = 'gold' AND D.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY C.gender
